description: This file contains extension methods for converting IConfiguration objects to JSON representations and vice versa, as well as handling configuration data asynchronously.

classes.name: ConfigurationExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IConfiguration and JsonObject conversions.

methods.name: ToJsonObject (IConfiguration)
methods.description: Converts an IConfiguration instance to a JsonObject.

methods.name: ToJsonNode (IConfiguration)
methods.description: Converts an IConfiguration instance to a JsonNode, handling nested structures and arrays.

methods.name: ToJsonObject (IDictionary<string, string>)
methods.description: Builds a JsonObject from a dictionary of configuration data.

methods.name: ToConfigurationDataAsync (JsonObject)
methods.description: Asynchronously converts a JsonObject to a dictionary of configuration data.
